selection_boundary: Rank uncovered Creative Fit regions by architecture-learning value and decision-state coverage. Do not use asset quantity, rights convenience, evidence collection difficulty, or current Production Feasibility to choose a Family.

phase_b_reference_truth.BW-F08: Nagi controlled Production / category education-open discovery
phase_b_reference_truth.human_visible_status: accepted upstream, including final narrow optical correction for uka

candidates.name: Guided Choice / Diagnostic Clarity
candidates.rationale: Adds category-accepted-but-cannot-self-select logic. It directly tests the accepted F05 vs F08 discriminator against Nagi and F05 vs F02 adjacency against Regina. The family mechanism is decision routing, not cards.

candidates.name: Local Human / Community Warmth
candidates.rationale: Adds locality/community/continuity as a decision-relevant trust mechanism. It directly tests the accepted F04 vs F07 boundary against uka: human warmth alone cannot promote F07; locality must materially change choice.

candidates.name: Sensory Sanctuary / Atmospheric Rest
candidates.rationale: Adds desire-through-sensory-imagination rather than education, craft provenance, or reassurance. It tests F01 vs F04 and protects shared Recognition-led/Atmosphere grammar from becoming a visual template.

candidates.name: Editorial High-Consideration / Aspirational Authority
candidates.rationale: Adds premium/aspirational authority that must survive into proof and commitment. It tests F03 vs F04 and F03 vs F01 while forcing editorial authorship beyond token-level luxury styling.

candidates.name: Proof-Led Process Authority
candidates.rationale: Dominant F06 remains unvalidated and must be productionized later. It is deferred only because Phase B already exercised F06 as secondary/collision context in both Regina (F02→F06) and uka (F04→F06), so the marginal new architecture coverage is lower than the four selected families in this phase.
